aspects.says: set checks nothing and the packager checks when SendResponse sends, after the vote; a participant packs a copy with the source channel's packager in prepare and answers without the field that didn't fit.
basis: section:6.5 `set` Checks Nothing; the Packager Checks After the Vote

aspects.says: Field 7 has no year and is in GMT: it takes the year closest to the clock and is read in GMT, whatever the JVM's default zone.
basis: section:6.4 A Date Without a Year Takes the Year Closest to the Clock, Read in GMT

aspects.says: Field 4 counts the minor units of the currency in field 49, whose decimals come from the currency, and an unknown currency must be answered rather than thrown.
basis: section:6.3 An Amount Counts the Minor Units of the Currency in Field 49

aspects.says: The packager checks a numeric field's length, not its characters, so field 4 must be checked for twelve digits before it is converted.
basis: section:6.2 A Numeric Field Is Text That Nobody Checked

aspects.says: A response that fails to pack is logged by the channel as a send with the error under it, while the TransactionManager's event shows a clean transaction.
basis: section:6.5 `set` Checks Nothing; the Packager Checks After the Vote

aspects.says: A missing field reads as null; a participant that throws while reading it gets an ABORTED vote and leaves no response, so the client gets nothing.
basis: section:6.1 A Missing Field Reads as `null`, and a Participant That Throws Answers Nobody
